verdict.rationale: Runloop's documentation covers the agent-driven loop end to end. Devboxes can be provisioned programmatically through SDKs, the CLI and an official MCP server, with fast startup. Code runs via command execution, and results come back as streamed or retrieved execution logs and file access. Shutdown and idle behaviors are documented, and the SDK rules list devbox lifecycle management. Missing for 10: no explicit snippet of a programmatic delete/shutdown call, no independent or hands-on corroboration of a fully unattended provision-to-teardown run.
